title: Paper Plane Field Notes
objective: Show, in one calm sequence, the four folds of a classic dart paper plane and why a heavy nose glides, so the viewer can fold one right after watching.
audience: Curious adults and older kids scrolling with sound off; no folding experience assumed.

message.core_message: Four sharp folds make a plane that glides.
key_points: Fold the corners to the crease
Fold the wings; keep the nose heavy
message.call_to_action: Grab a sheet and fold one.

avoid: brand marks or layouts from the reference corpus

constraints: Every format needs its own layout, not a crop
Original copy, drawing and choreography: reference videos are study material only

references.description: Reference corpus precedents (catalogue/data/reference-sources, inspiration-only rights). Typographic rhythm from the word-per-beat reels (ref-92c22222a2, ref-0bf0254a3d), a dot that draws and opens scenes (ref-49459ad8c1), a persistent frame and counters (ref-92c22222a2, ref-5924215625), one-stage step progression with a tracker (ref-c3bc609841, ref-95c96d5c47), margin notes (ref-392ee4d0f9), geometric morphs (ref-92c22222a2). Principles combined into an original piece; no assets, brands or shot sequences reused.

research.reason: Folding steps are common knowledge; the piece makes no measured or scientific claims (no distances or speeds).

creative_directions.name: Field notebook
creative_directions.concept: A naturalist's notebook page: three self-describing verbs open the piece, the last full stop becomes the page, one sheet folds in place step by step with hand-drawn margin notes, then the dot of its nose draws the flight across the page and opens the closing card.

visual_identity.palette: Warm paper, ink and one terracotta accent; green and mustard only for notes and the tracker.
visual_identity.typography: Playfair Display for verbs and headings, JetBrains Mono for frame labels and step names.
visual_identity.texture: Clean paper; hand-drawn loops and arrows for annotations.

motion_language.personality: Curious and precise: crisp folds, unhurried holds, one playful smear.
signature_moves: dot blooms into the next scene
motion_language.transitions: Element blooms from full stops; everything else changes in place on one stage.

composition.approach: One persistent stage: copy column and stepper beside (landscape) or under (portrait, square) a single folding sheet; a constant frame with corner labels.

creative_directions.pacing: Fast 0.9 s verb beats, then about 2.4 s per fold, a 2.5 s flight and a 3 s hold.
creative_directions.why_it_fits: A how-to needs orientation (tracker, single stage) and memorable verbs; the line of flight pays off the folds.

creative_directions.name: Swiss fold poster
creative_directions.concept: Hard-cut typographic poster: each fold is a full-frame card with a giant numeral and a flat diagram, cut on a 120 bpm grid.

composition.approach: Full-frame cards, numeral left, diagram right; portrait stacks them.

creative_directions.why_it_fits: Very legible and quick, but loses the sense of one sheet becoming a plane.

selection_rationale: Folding is a continuous transformation of one object; direction A keeps that object on one stage and orients the viewer with a tracker, while still borrowing the energy of word beats for the opening. Direction B would explain each fold in isolation.
success_criteria: Each fold is readable at phone size
The viewer can name the four folds
The ending holds for at least 2 seconds
No reference brand, layout or shot sequence is recognisable
